datasets.pds_dataset_product_name: MEDA data (Mars 2020 Mars Environmental Dynamics Analyzer)
datasets.instrument_sensor: Mars Environmental Dynamics Analyzer (MEDA) instrument package; Relative Humidity Sensor (HS); Thermal Infrared Sensor (TIRS); Air Temperature Sensor (ATS); pressure measurements
datasets.measurement_observable: Relative humidity (with respect to ice) at 1.45 m; atmospheric pressure; air temperature (including at 0.84 m); surface brightness temperature (ground temperature) used to derive water vapor pressure, H2O volume mixing ratio (VMR), and surface water activity (aw)
datasets.data_type_product_type: In-situ environmental time-series measurements (meteorology) and derived parameters (H2O VMR, water activity)
datasets.acquisition_date_time_range: First Martian year at Jezero crater (one full Martian year of MEDA surface measurements); examples include sols 285–305 (Ls=139°–149°) and sample sealing sols listed in Table 1 (Sol 120 through Sol 639)
datasets.location_coverage: Jezero crater, Mars; landing site given as 18.4663°N, 77.4298°E; measurements at 1.45 m above surface (HS), surface footprint for TIRS, and air temperature at 0.84 m used as comparable to sealing station height
datasets.spatial_resolution: TIRS footprint covers an ellipsoid area of 3–4 m²
datasets.temporal_resolution_cadence: Local-time coverage for reliable HS retrieval stated as ~20:00 to 07:00 LMST (daytime RH too low for accurate VMR retrieval)
datasets.pds_identifiers: PDS Atmospheres Node archive URL: https://pds-atmospheres.nmsu.edu/PDS/data/PDS4/Mars2020/mars2020_meda/ (bundle/directory name: mars2020_meda)
datasets.how_used: Used MEDA HS, TIRS, ATS, and pressure measurements to (1) derive seasonal/diurnal near-surface H2O VMR and precipitable water estimates, (2) compute surface water activity (aw) from derived water vapor pressure and ground temperature, and (3) provide temperature/pressure at the time of sample sealing for estimating headspace gas and H2O content in sealed tubes (Table 1, Figs. 2–4).

datasets.pds_dataset_product_name: Thermal Emission Spectrometer (TES) derived water column abundance climatology dataset (non-normalized to constant surface pressure)
datasets.measurement_observable: Total atmospheric H2O column abundance (precipitable microns) from TES climatology; used as daytime zonally averaged orbital observations for comparison to MEDA-derived columns
datasets.data_type_product_type: Orbital climatology/gridded column abundance dataset (3° latitude, 7.5° longitude, Ls=5° averaged bins; zonally averaged)
datasets.acquisition_date_time_range: Mars Years 24–27; daytime observations at ~14:00 LMST (MGS near-polar orbit)
datasets.location_coverage: Latitude bin encompassing Jezero crater: 18°–21°N; column abundances zonally averaged for the region
datasets.how_used: TES climatology water column abundance for MY24–MY27 was compared against MEDA-based nighttime column estimates to assess seasonal coherence and quantify discrepancies between daytime orbital columns and pre-dawn near-surface observations (Fig. 2 Bottom).

tool_validation.constraints_summary: PDS4 collections constrained to Mars 2020 investigation, Perseverance instrument host, Mars target, MEDA instrument; time window starting 2021-02-19; narrowed to Calibrated processing level and an end time of 2024-02-01 to isolate the single calibrated MEDA environmental collection version returned.

queries.query: Calibrated Mars Global Surveyor Thermal Emission Spectrometer atmospheric observations of Mars from the main mapping mission period (roughly 1999–2005) suitable for retrieving atmospheric temperature structure and aerosol opacity.

tool_validation.constraints_summary: Broad search: PDS4 collections with ref_lid_instrument=urn:nasa:pds:context:instrument:mgs.tes and ref_lid_target=urn:nasa:pds:context:target:planet.mars. Final narrowing added processing_level=Calibrated, yielding the single calibrated TES atmospheric collection (time coverage 1999-02-28 to 2005-02-16).

queries.query: Derived Mars Global Surveyor Thermal Emission Spectrometer daytime gridded climatology of Martian atmospheric dust optical depth in the visible, covering the mapping-era years starting in early 1999 through 2004.

tool_validation.constraints_summary: Broad search: PDS4 collections with ref_lid_instrument=urn:nasa:pds:context:instrument:mgs.tes and ref_lid_target=urn:nasa:pds:context:target:planet.mars. Final narrowing added processing_level=Derived and start_time=1999-03-01T00:00:00Z, which uniquely selected the derived visible dust column optical depth collection (time coverage 1999-03-12 to 2004-08-28).
